migration.backfill: Reclassify only existing deferred rows already carrying triageOutcome duplicate or discard as retired. Preserve still-wanted deferred rows without inventing owner, reason, trigger, or review evidence; they remain visibly nonconformant until reviewed through the governed lifecycle tool.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: The active projection exists only while status is deferred. Reactivation, completion, or retirement clears it, while BacklogItemActivity preserves the attributable decision history under the BacklogItem retention policy. Rollback is forward-only: application enforcement may be reverted without dropping nullable columns or deleting lifecycle evidence.

fields.reason: Retired separates demand intentionally removed from execution from delivered outcomes and still-wanted parked work.
fields.provenance: BI-59F6ED17; DI-6FA2FA858D95; deferred backlog governance plan

fields.reason: A retained deferral must explain why the work is not actionable now.
A retained deferral must name the observable condition that permits reconsideration.
A safety horizon makes parked demand reviewable even when its trigger has not fired.
Accountability resolves to the canonical Principal record rather than a display string or surface-specific user id.
fields.fieldPolicy: Store only the canonical Principal foreign key needed for accountability. Resolve display identity at read time, restrict mutation to manage_backlog capability, and clear the active projection when the item leaves deferred status.

fields.reason: The current parking interval needs an attributable start time distinct from the immutable activity history.
